breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two conflicting instructions for the time integration method: 'Explicit forward Euler' and a 'Semi-implicit' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the semi-implicit method. The generated specification correctly identified and resolved this conflict by exclusively describing the semi-implicit method and its corresponding linear system, completely omitting the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction.
